title: Knowledge Curation SLO Config
description: KP-06: kind-based freshness re-verify deadlines and the low-yield delivery threshold used by the weekly knowledge curation report. Declared here so thresholds are config, not hardcoded.

low_yield_delivery_threshold.description: A document is a low-yield candidate once delivered_count reaches this value with used_count still 0 (KP-05 usage aggregate).

freshness_days_by_kind.description: Re-verify deadline in days, keyed by frontmatter `kind` (e.g. governance, playbook, knowledge_hint).

default_freshness_days.description: Freshness threshold applied to documents whose kind has no entry in freshness_days_by_kind.
